info.title: Niu Customer Workspace & Billing Management API
info.description:
Model inference and management APIs for Niu. Browse the resource groups in the sidebar,
search by operation or path, and expand the request and response schemas for exact fields.

## Getting started
Use the [HTTP quickstart](/docs/guides/api-quickstart/) for your first model request,
or the [JavaScript SDK guide](/docs/guides/sdk-quickstart/) for typed clients.
[Download the complete OpenAPI 3.1 document](/docs/openapi/public.json).

## Authentication and scope
Inference uses a workspace API key. Management operations require the member session or explicit delegated workspace capability stated by that operation. These credentials
are not interchangeable. See each operation's security scheme and access description.
Legacy `project` field names refer to workspaces.

## Requests and responses
Send the documented Content-Type and use the declared request schema. Response status codes,
error bodies and pagination fields are operation-specific. Follow the returned cursor rather
than assuming a list is complete. Streaming operations document their event format separately.

Monetary amounts and large counters use the exact string representation in their schemas.
Preserve currency and rate units;

## Writes and retries
Where an operation documents an idempotency key, retry an uncertain outcome with the same
key and identical input. Preserve expected revisions for configuration updates; reload after
a conflict. A timeout does not prove that a write or an upstream generation did not execute.
Read the individual operation's retry and reconciliation behavior before resubmitting.

get.summary: List personal saved Chat history or one continuation page
get.description: Without limit or after, retain the latest-100 compatibility response. Either paging parameter selects a bounded page, default 50, ordered by updated time and ID descending within the authenticated owner, workspace and archive state. Session payload and customer-charge hydration share a read-only snapshot with 250 ms lock and 2 s statement limits. A changed, deleted, foreign-owner or different-archive cursor returns 409; pages are live views, not a frozen cross-request snapshot. Before loading saved bodies, paging also limits the sum of saved JSON text bytes to 32 MiB and may return fewer rows than limit; follow next_cursor. Customer-charge hydration can increase wire size. Legacy latest-100 calls over that saved-payload budget return 413 rather than truncated success.

put.summary: Save an owned Chat session in a workspace
put.description: Requires workspace write access. Stores conversation content separately from accounting. Only supported top-level and nested fields are retained. Client-supplied accounting fields are discarded. Numeric timestamps, durations and token counts must be nonnegative JavaScript-safe integers; token counts may be null. Settings and attachment shapes are validated. This endpoint does not establish authoritative request charges or detect secrets embedded in conversation text. Omit expectedRevision for a compatibility write only while the owned record has not enabled guarded writes. Explicit null creates only if no owned row exists; a canonical positive decimal revision updates only that exact owned version. Stale, missing or duplicate-create guarded writes return 409 without replacing content. Revisions are global sequence values, not timestamps, and are never reused by API delete/recreate. Guarded success includes a decimal revision; direct GET provides it. A successful guarded creation/update permanently enables guarded writes on that owned row. Compatibility saves thereafter return 409; there is no content-write downgrade. A content-free guard identity survives deletion, so legacy autosaves cannot resurrect a protected reference; explicit null guarded creation may recreate it. Untouched legacy rows retain compatibility behavior until guarded save.

turns.description: Ordered conversation turns. Each retains its prompt and up to four model responses, validated with the same result fields as the current turn. Unknown turn/result fields are stripped. Optional for legacy single-turn sessions.

post.summary: Explicitly save a generated output into workspace materials
post.description: Current dashboard workspace Write permission and actor-visible original task required. Task/output identity is scoped; no Provider URLs, private references, credentials or costs are returned. Explicit bounded copy into the existing encrypted workspace material library, not Provider registration or generation. Cached mode uses unexpired saved references under historical access; fresh mode explicitly queries the original task then retrieves output, using optional selected current workspace key or original-key fallback. The selected key cannot replace the immutable Provider/account/model/channel. Original expired keys without explicit current authority refuse fresh actions. Upstream operations never retry automatically. Two process capture slots; transport and format validation limited to8MiB; existing256asset/256MiB workspace quotas remain. A durable2minute preparing lease is committed before retrieval. Only an explicit repeated POST recovers failed/expired claims. Same requestid with changed fields409; a NEW requestid may change mode after failure; source identity prevents duplicate active/stored captures. Stored source replay returns canonical retained/deleted outcome without network; deleted retained bytes are never resurrected. Asset bytes, source provenance, quota and audit commit atomically after rechecking visibility under the source task lock. Failed delivery returns its error and retains a safe failed claim when storage is available; ambiguous failure-record writes leave preparing, not false availability. Cached expiry/deletion and original task/pricing identity are not rewritten. Fresh status queries may append diagnosis and settle an original pending liability through existing recovery, never create a new generation or reprice it. Saving shares copied bytes with authorized workspace members through the existing library; Provider readiness and verified identity remain separate.

get.summary: List saved Video tasks across workspace keys
get.description: Current dashboard workspace Read authorizes saved history even when its inference key is revoked, expired, or its model grants changed. No active key secret is needed. Actor-private session/intent tasks belonging to another actor are excluded. API-created tasks without a private association are workspace-readable. No prompt, upstream URL, asset URI, credential or procurement field is returned. This GET never dispatches, refreshes, retries or settles inference. Task pages use immutable created_at/id DESC; artifacts use immutable output created_at/task_id/kind DESC. active_requests.description: Current unresolved dispatch count shared across rotations; includes work admitted before configuration.

KeyConcurrencyConcurrencyLimit.description: Maximum unresolved dispatched requests; null is unlimited and zero denies dispatch.

known_tokens.description: Known provider usage completed within 60 seconds.

reserved_tokens.description: Estimates retained for unresolved usage, without time-based expiry.

unbounded_requests.description: Unknown dispatched requests without a saved bound.

committed_tokens.description: Known plus reserved tokens, or null when unbounded requests prevent a complete total.

KeyTokenRateTokenRateLimit.description: Token budget includes unresolved reservations plus provider-reported usage completed in the last 60 seconds. Null is unlimited; zero denies dispatch.

input_detectors.description: Required input detectors. Composes workspace and assigned-key restrictions. Only deployment-authorized workspaces and declared unmetered services can activate a current configuration fingerprint. Matched or indeterminate results fail closed before inference admission. Textual content only, after local redaction; unsupported content is denied. Paid and unknown-cost detectors remain synthetic-only.

input_rules.description: Local text rules enforced before dispatch. Workspace and assigned-key rules compose; unsupported content fails closed. At most 32 combined rules are supported.

output.description: Complete textual output inspection bounded to 1 MiB. Streaming, tools, structured-output requests and Embeddings are incompatible and rejected before inference in both modes. Buffered enforcement withholds indeterminate output; observation records matches or indeterminate coverage without redaction or denial. Observation sees the original response and cannot weaken inherited enforcement. Incurred usage remains chargeable. External output detectors and streaming inspection are not implemented.

AccessRule.description: Empty allowlists deny. Values must be exact, nonblank, trimmed identifiers without controls or wildcard; use allow_all explicitly.

request.description: Captured JSON request with known credential fields removed.

response.description: Sanitized retained output; empty when response_omitted is true.

response_omitted.description: True when truncated JSON cannot be safely parsed and its response body is withheld. Request content remains available.

unit.description: Unit for token rate fields only. Minimum and request fee are currency nanounits per known completed request.

reasoning_completion_rate.description: Reported reasoning output is a subset of total completion tokens. A configured rate prices that subset separately; missing quantity remains unresolved.

cache_write_prompt_rate.description: Reported cache-write input is a disjoint subset of aggregate input. A configured rate prices it separately; missing quantity remains unresolved.

minimum_input_tokens.description: Positive inclusive aggregate input threshold, at most 9223372036854775807.

prompt_rate.description: Integer currency nanounits per million tokens, at most 1000000000000000.

completion_rate.description: Integer currency nanounits per million tokens, at most 1000000000000000.

cached_prompt_rate.description: Integer currency nanounits per million tokens, at most 1000000000000000.

cache_write_prompt_rate.description: Integer currency nanounits per million tokens, at most 1000000000000000.

reasoning_completion_rate.description: Integer currency nanounits per million tokens, at most 1000000000000000.

context_tiers.description: Complete whole-request schedules; highest inclusive input threshold wins. Null category rates do not inherit the base schedule. Empty array clears tiers; omitting existing tiers conflicts.

requests_30d.description: Request operations created in the last 30 days; retries count once.

requests_by_day.description: UTC daily counts for today and the preceding 29 days, including zero days.

slug.description: Stable, readable workspace slug. Use in dashboard URLs; renaming preserves it.

slug_aliases.description: Previously issued slugs accepted for existing bookmarks.

name.description: Must contain non-whitespace text; at most 200 UTF-8 bytes before trimming. The saved name is trimmed.

organization_id.description: Company scope. Members default to their current company. Installation callers may omit it to create a Personal workspace company.

spending_limit.description: Optional lifetime retail cap in an existing company account currency. Requires an owner or installation administrator. Saved atomically with the workspace; omitted means no limit.

slug.description: Optional unique slug. When omitted, generated from the name using pinyin for Chinese, normalized separators, and a numeric suffix on collisions. The value default is reserved.

next_cursor.description: Present when limit or after selects paging. Null ends the directory.

WorkspaceKeyDetail.description: Workspace management key metadata and customer policies. Never contains the API secret or Provider procurement information.

token_usage_window.description: Null when no snapshot is available; never infer zero usage.

limit_nanos.description: Customer allowance in currency nanounits; null means unlimited.

committed_nanos.description: Customer committed amount in currency nanounits.

remaining_nanos.description: Remaining customer allowance in currency nanounits; null when unlimited.

revision.description: Decimal policy revision; null means no saved policy.

ApiErrorResponse.description: Gateway application error envelope. This does not describe framework body/path parsing failures or a proxy-generated response. Branch on error.type and HTTP status rather than matching message text.

message.description: Safe human-readable explanation; not a stable programmatic identifier.

type.description: Machine-readable failure category; new categories may be added.

code.description: HTTP status code, not a separate application error number.

token.description: One-time secret returned only on creation or rotation. Store securely; never included in key directories or detail reads.

key.description: Post-write detail snapshot; can be null if the key is removed before this read. The issued secret is still returned only once.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer credential accepted by this operation. Inference uses a workspace API key; management requires an authorized member session or installation credential. See the operation description for required authority and scope.

adminBearerAuth.description: Management bearer credential. The operation determines whether installation authority or a scoped member role is required; ordinary inference keys are insufficient.
